You see an opened fridge in the corner. The fridge contains an orange bell pepper, a red onion and a red hot pepper. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than an oven. Classic TextWorld. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a table. You shudder, but continue examining the table. The table is massive. The table appears to be empty. This always happens, here in TextWorld! You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a counter! You see a raw red potato, a raw yellow potato and a raw purple potato on the counter. You can see a stove. The stove is conventional. On the stove you see a chopped yellow bell pepper.



There is a raw pork chop, a block of cheese and a banana on the floor.
